findings.finding: Missing test for 127.0.0.1 loopback IP bypass attempt
findings.detail: Added rejects_loopback_ip test to ensure IP-based localhost bypass is caught

summary: Clean implementation following existing patterns. Three new config fields (ollama_url, ollama_model, rag_chunk_dir) with sensible defaults. OLLAMA_URL validation correctly uses url crate for parsing and enforces hostname whitelist. 9 unit tests cover valid and invalid cases including edge cases (HTTPS, IP addresses, empty string, malformed). Dead code annotations on McpState fields are appropriate since consumers arrive in Tasks 2-3.
